verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents is hosted at github.com/livekit/agents and documented as an open-source framework, with hands-on verification that the packages install and run without any account or key (pip/npm) and that the underlying server is Apache-2.0 OSS. The llms.txt docs also explicitly describe LiveKit as 'an open-source platform.' Missing for 10: an explicit license file/badge citation specifically for the livekit/agents repo (only inferred via probe evidence and sibling repo license).
